source_policy: SLI-curated public evidence snippets only; not the full national/provincial database. Upstream official sources remain publicly accessible at their respective websites.
rights_note: Each excerpt is newly authored from dated public-source observations. Original source publisher retains rights to underlying publications.
limitations: Not a generative AI model or prediction service.
Pro full-corpus RAG requires private source migration and authentication.
Publication dates and observed statistical periods may differ.
Absence of relevant evidence must never be replaced with invented figures.
Citations link to primary or original organizational sources; review official revisions.

documents.title: Integrated EV battery ecosystem
documents.text: Sektor: Critical minerals. Lokasi: Karawang, West Java; East Halmahera, North Maluku (multi-site). Status yang dilaporkan: Under construction. Investor/pihak: ANTAM · IBC · Ningbo Contemporary Brunp Lygend (CBL). Nilai diumumkan 5.9 USD billion, BUKAN belanja modal terealisasi. Groundbreaking of the six-subproject integrated ecosystem confirmed 29 June 2025. This is a consortium-wide figure, not single-factory spending. Sumber sampai 2025-06-29; bukan konfirmasi kondisi real-time.

documents.title: Microsoft Indonesia cloud and AI program
documents.text: Sektor: AI infrastructure. Lokasi: Indonesia (multi-location program). Status yang dilaporkan: Announced. Investor/pihak: Microsoft. Nilai diumumkan 1.7 USD billion, BUKAN belanja modal terealisasi. Microsoft announced a four-year program in April 2024; Komdigi reaffirmed commitment September 2026. Value includes cloud/AI infrastructure and skilling, not verified data-center construction spending. Sumber sampai 2024-04-30; bukan konfirmasi kondisi real-time.

documents.title: IGP Pomalaa — mine and HPAL
documents.text: Sektor: Critical minerals. Lokasi: Kolaka, Southeast Sulawesi. Status yang dilaporkan: Under construction. Investor/pihak: PT Vale Indonesia · PT Kolaka Nickel Indonesia · Huayou · Ford (project partners). Nilai diumumkan 4.5 USD billion, BUKAN belanja modal terealisasi. PT Vale disclosed 62% overall project progress in February 2026; ore-sales milestone in March 2026 should not be conflated with HPAL operation. Sumber sampai 2026-02-25; bukan konfirmasi kondisi real-time.

documents.title: PTFI Manyar copper smelter
documents.text: Sektor: Critical minerals. Lokasi: Gresik, East Java. Status yang dilaporkan: Operational. Investor/pihak: PT Freeport Indonesia (PTFI); shareholder groups MIND ID / PT IPMM / FCX. Nilai belum diverifikasi. FCX reports May 2025 startup and July 2025 first cathode; 2025 production and post-September 2025 concentrate constraints mean operational status does not equal full utilization. Sumber sampai 2025-12-31; bukan konfirmasi kondisi real-time.

documents.title: Digital Edge CGK Campus · data center
documents.text: Operator: Digital Edge. Lokasi GIIC, Bekasi (West Java). Tahap: under construction; kapasitas 500 MW (initial planned capacity); bukan kapasitas sudah beroperasi. Geocode sourced to facility directory; phase I commissioning not established. Periode sumber: 2026-06-01.

documents.title: PDG JC3 · data center
documents.text: Operator: Princeton Digital Group. Lokasi GIIC, Bekasi (West Java). Tahap: under construction; kapasitas 120 MW (planned capacity); bukan kapasitas sudah beroperasi. Contracted dual grid feeds; reported Q4 2026 phase-one target. Periode sumber: 2025-11-19.

documents.title: PDG JC4 · data center
documents.text: Operator: Princeton Digital Group. Lokasi GIIC, Bekasi (West Java). Tahap: under construction; kapasitas 240 MW (planned capacity); bukan kapasitas sudah beroperasi. Construction reported commenced; located about 1.7 km from JC3. Periode sumber: 2026-04-30.

documents.title: Cara membaca pertumbuhan, Gini, dan investasi
documents.text: Pertumbuhan riil PDRB dan Rasio Gini pengeluaran diukur pada periode berbeda, sehingga hubungan keduanya bersifat deskriptif dan tidak membuktikan kausalitas. PMTB adalah komponen pembentukan modal dalam neraca daerah, bukan realisasi proyek BKPM. Multiplier effect memerlukan data input-output dan model yang diuji; tidak boleh disimpulkan dari korelasi saja.
